injects.title: Initial System Formation
injects.description: Alert A issued: A Low-Pressure System (LPS) has formed 750 km from Karachi on June 27th. It is expected to strengthen into a Tropical Depression by June 28th.

injects.title: Tropical Depression Confirmation
injects.description: Alert B issued: The system has intensified into a Tropical Depression (TD) 692 km from Karachi with wind gusts of 70–80 km/h. Trajectory is towards the Sindh coast.
